description: This program offers an integrated blend of theoretical learning and practical, hands-on experience through laboratory and pilot-scale training. Participants gain comprehensive exposure to key areas such as operation of bioprocess equipment, cell culture techniques, microbial fermentation, downstream purification, process validation, and automation systems. The curriculum emphasizes adherence to Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), regulatory compliance, process optimization, and quality control. By the end of the program, learners will be well-equipped to meet the operational, technical, and quality requirements of contemporary biopharmaceutical manufacturing environments.
